crossRefs.note: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim…

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Rephaim
people.line: A race of giants who inhabited Canaan

translations.web: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
translations.bsb: (That too was regarded as the land of the Rephaim, who used to live there, though the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.
translations.kjv: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
translations.asv: (That also is accounted a land of Rephaim: Rephaim dwelt therein aforetime; but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
